verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU byonna abimanyi,
Kinsanyusa;
Antwala yekka mu kkubo,
Seetaaga mukulembezi,
Wabula ye,wabula ye.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ebiribaawo sibitya,
Ng'antwala nze;
Yesu yekka-ankulembera
Nange ka mugoberere,
Kinsaanidde,kinsaanidde.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Siyinza kwerabirira
Ndi munafu;
Ankutte-omukono gwange
Antambuza mu bulabe,

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Nnina-ekiddukiro gy'ali,
Kya maanyi nnyo;
Ekitalumbika babi
Ekirimu bye neetaaga,
Ne mpummula,ne mpummula.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kyenvudde musanyukira
Bw'ambeera nze,
Ebitayinzika gye ndi
By'asoboola,by'amala ye,
Gwe njagala,gwe njagala.
